description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Grinding Station and Stalwart Successor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Stalwart Successor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
